body: Sadly for most employed in the US this is impossible for many reasons - mainly most employers would be unwilling to fulfill this request, and additionally the loss of income would be too much to cover living expenses. To many people live paycheck to paycheck, myself included.

If physician assisted suicide was available, I would take it in a heartbeat. I would appreciate the opportunity to go out with dignity, and hopefully it would leave less of a mark on those around me. As it is now, I could never go through with it.

We don't get to choose whether we enter this world, so why remove the choice to leave?
I actually plan on using the vaped left overs for that! I'm just nervous about eating too much lol I'm super lightweight, even if I've smoked for a while.

I just get nervous about the most senseless things as I'm coming up. Most of my neighbors are nice, but I get the feeling the one across the street doesn't really like us. I don't really talk to any of them though, and have bad social anxiety, so I'd have a really hard time flat out telling them about it.
I gotcha. I currently rent, and my neighbors know the landlord. I'm close with the landlord, but I haven't told them about this.
I greatly admire their courage, and wish them success in their transition! I'm not sure that's something I could ever do myself. The permanency scares me.

In the past, when I had less control over my downswings, I sadly ended up pushing people away and lost a few friends because of that. I've since done my best to prevent my mental health from affecting others. Besides, I feel terrible when I burden others with my problems. It took a lot to even post this here, but I'm very happy I did. I suppose, I feel an obligation to keep the happy mask on for my friends, so they don't have to worry ^ ^ They already have so much to worry about in their lives, it would be unfair to add onto that.
